author: Chase
text: Donnie is wonderful, kind and deeply generous.  He came within an hour of an emergency drain problem, and was diligent about locating the problem.  What a gift!  And, he continues to give us peace of mind.  For any drain issues in the future (please, no more), we will most definitely call him first!  Thank you, Donnie, for easing our minds and taking such good care of our home.

author: Laura Whitney
text: Donnie was QUICK and responsive especially when we were dealing with an issue “after hours.” He was so nice and explained everything to us. Will definitely use him again! He fixed our basement clog issue.

author: Jarid Sinkler
text: Clearflow has been such a life saver!  As a property manager, it's vitally important that we have fast response on drain issues.  We have to satisfy a tenant/customer that needs use of their plumbing, and we have to satisfy owner/investors who are cost conscious.  I am thankful to call on Clearflow, who is always on top of it!

author: Michelle Johnson
text: Donnie was great! He got out to my house in record time and got my kitchen sink drain cleaned quickly and efficiently. He even got my garbage disposal working again! Highly recommended.

author: Brad Reisfeld
text: Donnie did an outstanding job on my sewer clean-out. He was very professional, respectful, and friendly, and was able to get my job on his schedule amazingly quickly. I highly recommend Donnie and Clearflow!
